# Budibase

> > Budibase is a low-code platform for building AI agents and workflow automation tools that integrate with enterprise systems and data sources.

Budibase enables teams to create internal tools, IT helpdesk systems, and automated workflows using drag-and-drop builders and AI capabilities powered by Mistral 3, Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI. The platform is trusted by organizations including the Bulgarian Government, Schnellecke, and Ströer-x.

## Key Topics

- AI agents
- Workflow automation
- Low-code development
- Internal tools
- IT helpdesk
- Data integration (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Google Sheets)
- REST API authentication
- Drag-and-drop builder
- Access control
- Request management
- Budibase AI
- Mistral 3, Anthropic, OpenAI integrations
- Slack and Gmail integrations
- Enterprise customers (Bulgarian Government, Schnellecke, Ströer-x)
- Case studies and testimonials
